youtube.text:
Which has more vitamin C, an orange or a bell pepper? Orange or red bell pepper, banana or baked potato, ketchup or cola. Three seconds each, numbers per 100 g from USDA FoodData Central.

More vitamin C: Red bell pepper (128 mg vs 53.2 mg per 100 g)
More potassium: Baked potato (535 mg vs 358 mg per 100 g)
More sugar: Ketchup (21.3 g vs 9.94 g per 100 g)
